item.title: [MEDIUM] Scans for Solana (Surfpool?) Endpoints, (Mon, Aug 10th)
item.description: Solana is a crypto platform known for speed. Developers like it to develop distributed applications or to implement crypto payments. To interact with the blockchain, APIs are provided for developers. These APIs will either "speak" JSON or gRPC. One implementation often used for development is "surfpool," which is used to test programs before deploying them to a Solana network.
